## History

Pendexter accompanied famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) on an unexpected visit to Anne's home. During the call, she and the other distinguished guests were hosted by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for a pleasant meal. Following the meal, Pendexter and the group went on a stroll through the local sights before departing.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P2](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0002), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P4](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P5](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0005), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P7](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0007), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009), +18 more_

## Relationships

### [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--pendexter.md)

Mrs. Pendexter is a friend and traveling companion of Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), visiting [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) alongside her and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md). During their visit, they are hosted by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for a pleasant meal and a tour of the local sights before departing together.
